items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: I showed Barney a menu a few days ago

ctx.x: Café Society must have been quite a showcase...

I showed Barney a menu a few days ago where back in 1946, something like that you could get a complete dinner for a dollar fifty cents. They had the standing there dollar and fifty cents/ like it had a halo. (Laughter).
And a dollar cover charge or something like that...
